overview.title: Shade, Birds and a Short City Pause
overview.p1: The Valley of the Birds (Vallée des Oiseaux) is a modest city park: paths, aviaries and a pocket of green when the beach glare is too much. It will not fill a whole day, but it is a useful family stop or a quiet hour between heavier plans.
overview.p2: Expect a local park rather than a major attraction. Check opening times and any small entry fee on the day you go.
overview.p3: Combine with the beach or souk the same day. Keep expectations proportional to the size of the site.

q2.question: Is there an entry fee?
q2.answer: Sometimes a small fee — carry change.

q3.question: Worth it without kids?
q3.answer: Only if you want shade and a short walk; prioritise Kasbah and beach first.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Valley of the Birds?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for context and timing.

q5.question: Is Valley of the Birds suitable for families?
